identification: Unpainted relief carving of a moustached man in a rope-banded alpine hat smoking a bent pipe, cut into a hollowed half-log section with scalloped top edge and tool-textured (chip-cut) surround. Light timber (lime or pine), natural finish, H 58 cm. Alpine/Bavarian folk-souvenir type, probably mid-late 20th century, possibly an immigrant hobby carver's work. Estimate 60-100.
